text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And if that's the case, then...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nothing... I just realized I probably
shouldn't be
asking you this, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I was wondering... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. In that case, I won't hold
back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how much you know
about
games.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You see, there's a mobile game that
Taishin has
been obsessed with lately.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She's been so engrossed in it that I grew
short
with her and told her to give it a
break. Then, it
turned into an argument.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But after reconsidering things, I felt bad
for
scolding her. She never bothers me
whenever I'm
deep in thought, after all...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Taishin understands how important
thinking time
is to me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't even try to see things from
her
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So, back to my initial question...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How much do you know about games?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm ashamed to admit I don't have the
faintest
idea what's popular nowadays
since I've never
played any.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you!

And so, Biwa Hayahide and I start doing
research
on popular mobile games
together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow. There are so many different
genres
available. I don't even know
where to start.

I try to think of what kind of game would
suit
Biwa Hayahide's diligent and
methodical
personality.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've heard of this one! Maybe
Taishin plays it
too!

Biwa Hayahide starts playing the puzzle
game.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the next piece is a yellow
column...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I slide this square piece to the right,
it'll create
a space on the left...

She moves the puzzle pieces around with

lightning quick judgment, and her score
keeps
going higher and higher.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I did it! I beat the game!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand now. I was a fool to disdain
these
simply because they're mobile
games.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! This game is actually great fun,
and it helps
my focus too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Taishin feels the same elation
when
she plays games. Hmm...

The next day, Biwa Hayahide talks to
Narita
Taishin, and they have a great
time playing the
puzzle game together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm pretty sure Taishin was playing
something
like this!

Biwa Hayahide starts playing the racing
game.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ah! I have to turn! No, no! Not
that way!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That's not fair! You can't just crash
into me
like that!

Biwa Hayahide tilts her body this way
and that as
she steers her race car
around.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can see how Taishin might get sucked
into this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You must calculate your acceleration
and max
speed based on the course
layout, all while
watching out for your
opponents.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'd get pretty mad too if
someone started
lecturing me while I was
in the middle of an
intense race...

The next day, Biwa Hayahide apologizes
to
Narita Taishin, and they have fun
playing the
racing game together.
